title: Residual Decoding: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via History-Aware Residual Guidance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating object hallucinations and visual grounding using multimodal benchmarks such as POPE, CHAIR, and HallusionBench to measure the model's tendency to rely on linguistic patterns, textual context, and statistical pre-training statistics rather than the actual visual input.
